T: Croquet in the morning. Slushies at night.
D: A teenager falls in with a dangerous new boyfriend who has a deadly answer to the school's popular clique.
P: Serve the drinks when J.D. and Veronica stop at the convenience store for slushies.
S: Crunchy fried corn kernels tossed in butter, chilli and lime

Dried corn kernels soaked, fried until puffed and crunchy, then tossed in melted butter, chilli powder, lime zest and salt. Soak 300g dried corn kernels in water overnight, drain and dry very well on tea towels. Fry in batches in 180C oil for about 6 minutes, using a lid as they pop, until puffed and crunchy. Drain on paper. Toss hot with 20g melted butter, 1 tsp chilli powder, the zest of a lime and 1 tsp salt. Cool so they stay crisp.
the croquet game in the opening scene

Soft white bread filled with smoked trout whipped into cream cheese with lemon and dill, thin cucumber, crusts off and cut into neat fingers. Flake 200g smoked trout and beat into 150g soft cream cheese with the zest and juice of half a lemon, chopped dill and pepper. Spread over 6 slices of soft white bread. Top with thin ribbons of a Lebanese cucumber and 6 more buttered slices. Press gently, trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers. Cover with a damp tea towel until serving.
Toasted baguette with whipped ricotta, crushed raspberries and honey
Baguette sliced and toasted with olive oil, spread with whipped ricotta, topped with fresh raspberries crushed with a little sugar and a drizzle of honey.
M: Cafeteria schnitzel with mash and gravy
the high school cafeteria where the Heathers rule

Chicken breasts pounded thin, crumbed in panko and fried golden in butter and oil, with buttery mashed potato, minted peas and a pan gravy. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 120g panko. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Fry the schnitzels in 30g butter and oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Cook 300g peas with mint.
Beef and pork ragu layered with béchamel and mozzarella, baked 45 minutes
Beef and pork ragù simmered 2 hours with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and rested 20.
W: Red velvet cupcakes with cream cheese frosting
Red velvet cupcakes of buttermilk, cocoa and red colouring baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with cream cheese frosting, a red sugar dot on top.
K: Cherry juice and lemonade blended with ice into a slushie
Cherry juice and lemonade blended with plenty of ice until slushy, poured into tall cups with a straw and a spoon.

s.note: Toasted baguette with whipped ricotta, crushed raspberries and honey
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast. Spread with 200g whipped ricotta. Top with 200g raspberries crushed with a little sugar and drizzle with honey.

m.note: Beef and pork ragu layered with béchamel and mozzarella, baked 45 minutes
m.how: Simmer 500g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 tins tomatoes and red wine for 2 hours. Make béchamel with 50g butter, 50g flour and 600ml milk. Layer with 300g lasagne sheets and 250g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20 minutes.

w.note: Red velvet cupcakes with cream cheese frosting
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 200g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 200ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar and add a red sugar dot.

d.note: Cherry juice and lemonade blended with ice into a slushie
d.how: Blend 500ml cherry juice with 300ml lemonade and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into tall cups with a straw and a spoon. How very.
